source: ECharts 6.1.0 dist (D:/Projects/echarts/dist/echarts.js) + zrender 6.1.0, node SSR (svg), controlled clock
note: D5 UT3: steps of setOption (the first at T0; a next one after the previous ran out, T + 10000, or `after` ms into it; notMerge unless `merge`), recorded at the last T + samples. Each element: an item path of a new series (id s<series>/<dataIndex>/<path>) or another path of its view (s<series>/x/<k>); morph[i] = __morphT >= 0 and not combining, d[i] the replaced buildPath's PathProxy data (codes M1 L2 C3); comb[i] = __isCombineMorphing, pieces = its childrenRef() in order (present, morph, d, style); style = the effective fill / stroke / lineWidth / opacity, snap = the path's transform and shape keys, g.* its parent group's -- a key the same at every sample written once. direction: 0 none, 1 parent -> child, 2 child -> parent, sniffed on the dist's flattenDataDiffItems of every old and every new series; oldGroups / newGroups: [groupId, childGroupId] per flattened item (null for undefined). Every number is the hex of its double; a digest case writes a path as fnv<count>:<FNV-1a 32 of the hexes joined by ",">.

charts.note: bar-multi-drilldown, things -> animals: the new groupId "animals" is an old childGroupId (parent -> child, the old side keyed by its childGroupId): Animals separates into three bars (clone), Fruits and Cars leave
two levels down, things -> animals -> dogs: Dogs separates into three
things -> animals -> things: the new childGroupId "animals" is an old groupId (child -> parent, the new side keyed by its childGroupId): the three bars combine into Animals, Fruits and Cars enter
two levels down and back up, the last step animals -> things
things -> fruits -> citrus -> fruits: nine leaves (childGroupId "NaN": the encoded column, never written, is a float one) combine into Citrus
things -> cars with notMerge (a new view): SUV and Sports separate out of Cars
dogs -> cats: leaves with no children both sides, no common group -- no transition
animals -> fruits: no direction, the groups differ -- no transition
200 ms into things -> animals, things again: the separating bars combine back
200 ms into animals -> things, animals again: the combining Animals separates from its children
200 ms into things -> animals, dogs: Dogs separates from where its morph was
raw items: bars with childGroupIds -> slices grouped by them: Animals splits into two sectors (split), Fruits one to one, Cars leaves, Vans enters
and back up: Dogs and Cats combine into the Animals bar, Pomes one to one into Fruits
a childGroupId that matches nothing: no direction, the groupIds pair the items (g separates in two, h one to one)
child -> parent where a new item has no childGroupId: its key is "undefined", which pairs it with the old item whose groupId is the string "undefined"
both directions present, the child -> parent item first: it wins (Q into n0)
both directions present, the parent -> child item first: it wins (P into n1)
one new item both ways: parent -> child is asked first
two bar series a and b with childGroupIds -> one series whose seriesKey lists them (many old series in one batch): parent -> child, A of a separates into two, A of b into three
and back up: the list series splits into a and b (one batch, oldDataMapForSplit), child -> parent -- the bars grouped ka combine into A of a, kb into A of b
numeric group columns (float dimensions): the groups are the numbers' strings, a missing child is "NaN"
and back up
an ordinal group column led by "", a declared int child column (1.7 -> "1", -0.5 -> "0"): A separates into a and b, B into d, C into c
treemap-sunburst-transition: the treemap becomes the sunburst (the same tree, every id the same: one to one, rects into sectors)
and the sunburst becomes the treemap
300 ms into tm-sb, the treemap again: each rect morphs from the frame its sector was drawing
a sunburst drilled to a (sunburstRootToNode: the return circle is the virtual root's piece, data index 0) becomes a treemap of the same tree
the same treemap with a new palette: one view, its own update -- a treemap keeps no old style, so the transition animates no style
